issues.description: In the template for GroverKakuro.state_preparation the parameter is named 'ancilla_register', but the problem statement and the rest of the template/solution consistently use the name 'auxiliary_register'. This mismatch between the template parameter name and the expected name used elsewhere (including the solution implementation) can confuse students and cause them to implement the method using the wrong parameter name or to experience errors when wiring the oracle/diffusion methods which expect 'auxiliary_register'.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter in the template method signature from 'ancilla_register' to 'auxiliary_register' and update the docstring accordingly so parameter names are consistent with the rest of the template, the problem statement, and the solution. For example: def state_preparation(self, qc, query_register, auxiliary_register) -> QuantumCircuit: ...

issues.description: The template's state_preparation method in ex5_grover_kakuro.py uses the parameter name 'ancilla_register' while the rest of the template, the solution implementation, and the problem statement consistently refer to this register as 'auxiliary_register' (or 'auxiliary qubit'). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (the auxiliary/ancilla qubit/register used for phase kickback and multi-controlled operations) can confuse students mapping the problem description to the template and the expected solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter 'ancilla_register' in the template's state_preparation signature and corresponding uses to 'auxiliary_register' and update the docstring to match the terminology used throughout the problem statement and solution. This aligns identifiers across artifacts and reduces student cognitive load.
